steps.cmd: gamemode survival DPTester1
item replace entity DPTester1 weapon.mainhand with minecraft:iron_axe
execute at DPTester1 run tp DPTester1 ~ ~ ~ 0 0
function timberstrike:config
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~3 ~ ~3 ~3 ~6 ~3 minecraft:oak_log
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~1 ~4 ~1 ~5 ~6 ~5 minecraft:oak_leaves replace minecraft:air
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~3 ~3 ~3 ~3 ~6 ~3 minecraft:oak_log
execute at DPTester1 run setblock ~3 ~ ~3 minecraft:air
execute at DPTester1 run summon minecraft:item ~3.5 ~.5 ~3.5 {Age:0s,Item:{id:"minecraft:oak_log",count:1}}
scoreboard players set DPTester1 ts.oakmined 1
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~-3 ~ ~3 ~-3 ~7 ~3 minecraft:birch_log
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~-5 ~5 ~1 ~-1 ~7 ~5 minecraft:birch_leaves replace minecraft:air
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~-3 ~4 ~3 ~-3 ~7 ~3 minecraft:birch_log

execute at DPTester1 run summon minecraft:item ~-3.5 ~.5 ~3.5 {Age:0s,Item:{id:"minecraft:birch_log",count:1}}
scoreboard players set DPTester1 ts.birchmined 1
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~6 ~ ~3 ~6 ~9 ~3 minecraft:spruce_log
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~4 ~7 ~1 ~8 ~9 ~5 minecraft:spruce_leaves replace minecraft:air
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~6 ~6 ~3 ~6 ~9 ~3 minecraft:spruce_log
execute at DPTester1 run setblock ~6 ~ ~3 minecraft:air
execute at DPTester1 run summon minecraft:item ~6.5 ~.5 ~3.5 {Age:0s,Item:{id:"minecraft:spruce_log",count:1}}
scoreboard players set DPTester1 ts.sprucemined 1
